items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: Not any movie that I was on. There’s some that I really — are hard to listen to now. There’s one called “Hoosiers” with Gene Hackman where they wanted me to play Simmons drums.

ctx.x: Off hand, yeah. Not any movie that I was on. There’s some that I really — are hard to listen to now. There’s one called “Hoosiers” with Gene Hackman where they wanted me to play Simmons drums. And the producer and the director were really, really keen on the Simmons drum sound, all this electronic stuff. And I see the movie now, even just 30 seconds of it and it makes me cringe because the Simmons drums were so loud in the mix and it sounds so dated, you know it sounds so 70s 80s electronic music.
